video_caption: The video opens with a static graphic featuring a smiling Harry Maguire, a male soccer player, on the right, wearing a red Manchester United jersey. Large red text across the center reads "HARRY MAGUIRE", with smaller white text below stating "TAKE ME HOME UNITED ROAD" and a white box at the bottom containing "MAGUIRE SIGNS FOR UNITED". A small logo with "UTP TV" is in the top left corner. The scene then transitions to a photograph of two smiling men seated at a table against a black background adorned with Adidas and Kohler logos. On the left is a man with short, light hair wearing a black Adidas shirt, while on the right, Harry Maguire, in a blue Adidas polo shirt, holds a pen as if signing a document. This is followed by a close-up still image of Harry Maguire, smiling and wearing a red Manchester United jersey, set against a textured red background.

A man with short reddish-blonde hair and a beard, wearing a grey t-shirt and a gold hoop earring in his left ear, speaks directly to the camera against a dense background of lush green bamboo plants and a partially visible wooden fence on the left. He is expressive, using facial movements as he talks, and at one point gestures subtly with his head. In the top left corner, a red and black logo for "UP TV" is displayed, beneath which a black bar contains the text "SPONSORED BY UNIBET" with the Unibet logo featuring five green dots. At the bottom of the screen, a red bar on the left says "SUBSCRIBE TO UNITED PEOPLES TV," while a wider red bar on the right displays "MAN UNITED CONFIRM HARRY MAGUIRE" in large white letters. Below this, a scrolling white text banner reads: "MAN UNITED HAVE ANNOUNCED THE SIGNING OF HARRY MAGUIRE FOR A WORLD RECORD PRICE FOR A DEFENDER AND HE BECOMES OLE GUNNAR SOLSKJAER'S THIRD MAJOR SIGNING THIS SUMMER." (Manchester United has announced the signing of Harry Maguire for a world record price for a defender, and he becomes Ole Gunnar Solskjær's third major signing this summer.) The man explains that he has been away at a wilderness festival with no phone signal and also broke his finger, which explains his delayed reaction to recent football news.
